in_marathi.name: Baanbhatt
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Banana tree warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baanbhatt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Baanbhatt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'baan' (banana tree) and 'bhatt' (warrior). This name is a tribute to the brave warriors who were known to possess the strength and resilience of a banana tree.
